notes: The key lemma avoids the documented pitfall, but concluding discreteness requires the unstated assumption that V_{n+2}(z) is a neighbourhood. Take X={0}∪{1/k:k≥1} with its usual topology, well-ordered as 0≺1≺1/2≺⋯, and V_m=Δ_X for every m. All stated hypotheses hold, but A_n(x)={x}, and the singleton family is not discrete at 0. The proof establishes the conclusion only under its added neighbourhood assumption.
